newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras says rate cuts won't hurt revenue.
newsitem.headline: Telebras says rate cuts won't hurt revenue.

text.p: Brazil's Telebras said Friday possible rate cuts in August would apply to a maximum of 25 of its largest customers and would not hurt the federal telecommunications holding company's revenues.
"This applies to a maximum of 25 mega-clients, the really big national and multinationals," a Telebras spokesman said.
The spokesman said global telecom pacts with Concert Communications Services and WorldPartners meant it could cut corporate rates from August.
Shares of Telebras, or Telecomunicacoes Brasileiras SA, plunged after a company official on Thursday said competition would force Telebras to cut tariffs.
The spokesman on Friday said the comments -- made by Telebras' director of services, Daltron Magalhaes -- had been misunderstood.
